UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
DISTRICT OF NEVADA

NOTICE OF MOTION AND MOTION TO EXTEND TIME

TO ALL PARTIES AND THEIR COUNSEL OF RECORD:

PLEASE TAKE NOTICE that Defendant Silver State Logistics will and hereby does move this Court for an order extending the deadline to respond to Plaintiff's First Set of Interrogatories by fourteen days. This motion is made on the grounds that counsel for Defendant was engaged in trial in another matter during the response period and that Plaintiff's counsel does not oppose the requested extension.

This motion is based on this notice, the attached declaration of counsel, the pleadings and papers on file in this action, and such further evidence and argument as the Court may permit.

DECLARATION OF COUNSEL

I am counsel of record for Defendant. From May 2 through May 12, 2024, I was in trial in Clark County District Court. I conferred with Plaintiff's counsel on May 13, 2024, who confirmed that Plaintiff does not oppose a fourteen-day extension. I declare under penalty of perjury that the foregoing is true and correct.

PROPOSED ORDER

Good cause appearing, the deadline is extended to June 10, 2024.
